span.p:
H-7 order perpanjangan + email
H-1 pengingat · H grace (berhenti: suspended)
H+1, H+7 tenggang · H+8 suspended (503)
H+14 win-back · H+28 peringatan hapus
H+30 expired → site.purge

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
H-30 quote + order domain_renewal
H-7, H-3 pengingat · lewat H-3 batal
habis: expired, kembali ke subdomain

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Tahanan kursi > 30 menit: released
Perubahan terjadwal tak dibayar H+7:
cancelled + kursi dilepas

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:

dalam satu transaksi
